question: Can a jointly trained multimodal persistent computational chain carry cross-modal information into later queries, selectively address persistent state, execute a learned operator choice, verify the post-action outcome, and remain capable on held-out modality/operator/query compositions?

information_flow.pre_action: text,image,audio -> encoders -> shared representation -> persistent write -> query-conditioned read -> operator selection -> action
information_flow.post_action: environment outcome -> verifier -> differentiable write gate -> persistent state update

controls.no_memory: zero all persistent values before query
controls.shuffle_one_modality: permute image observations across entities while leaving text/audio aligned
controls.unimodal: zero two of the three modality streams
controls.heldout_composition: evaluation query tuples are absent from training query tuples

scientific_boundaries: Synthetic multimodal evidence is a mechanism benchmark, not real-world semantic multimodal capability.
Finite training/evaluation results do not establish scaling laws.
Auxiliary representation losses are training scaffolds and are not available at inference.
The verifier receives post-action environment feedback; it must not be interpreted as a pre-action oracle.
The first phase does not claim that end-to-end learning makes every component necessary; necessity is tested by ablation.

title: Jointly trained multimodal persistent computation over complementary text, image, and audio evidence
hypothesis: The jointly trained chain can carry useful cross-modal information into later queries and execute held-out operator/index compositions using persistent state, while performance depends materially on persistence and aligned multimodal evidence.

arms.name: integrated
arms.intervention: jointly train the full registered chain with text, image, audio, persistent state, addressing, CASM, verifier and state update

arms.name: no_memory
arms.intervention: zero persistent state immediately before query

arms.name: shuffle_image
arms.intervention: permute image observations across entities while preserving text/audio

endpoints.name: heldout_q2_accuracy_all_modalities
endpoints.role: primary — held-out q2 action accuracy with integrated chain
endpoints.description: Mean q2 action accuracy over 400 post-training episodes per seed on the fixed held-out operator/index compositions, with all three modalities and persistent state active.

endpoints.name: operator_selection_accuracy
endpoints.role: secondary — selected operator matches queried operator

endpoints.name: target_memory_attention
endpoints.role: secondary diagnostic — attention mass assigned to queried entity slot

endpoints.name: memory_drop_seed_bootstrap_ci
endpoints.role: uncertainty — 95% seed-bootstrap interval for paired memory drop

endpoints.name: alignment_drop_seed_bootstrap_ci
endpoints.role: uncertainty — 95% seed-bootstrap interval for paired alignment drop

decision_rule.condition: all preregistered benchmark-integrity and information-flow checks pass, and mean integrated held-out q2 accuracy is at least 0.80 with every seed at least 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: the registered synthetic multimodal persistent-computation chain meets the primary capability criterion on the held-out compositions
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world language, image or audio understanding; learned arbitrary operator synthesis; asymptotic scaling; or AGI

decision_rule.condition: the integrity checks pass but the primary capability criterion is not met
decision_rule.licenses: the integrated architecture does not meet the preregistered primary criterion on this synthetic benchmark; diagnostics are retained for localization
decision_rule.does_not_license: that the PLM architecture is impossible or that any individual mechanism is disproven

decision_rule.condition: a held-out query composition is present in TRAIN_COMBOS, the pre-action API receives the answer, or a control is evaluated on different episodes from the integrated arm
decision_rule.licenses: the experiment is instrument-invalid and no capability interpretation is permitted

decision_rule.condition: integrated q2 accuracy exceeds no-memory q2 accuracy on the paired evaluation episodes
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that persistent state contributes to this benchmark outcome

decision_rule.condition: integrated q2 accuracy exceeds shuffled-image q2 accuracy on the paired evaluation episodes
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that aligned multimodal observations contribute to this benchmark outcome
decision_rule.does_not_license: a claim that all three modalities are individually necessary without the unimodal diagnostics

held_constant: text bits 0-3, image bits 4-7, audio bits 8-11
two queries per episode with different target entities
held-out composition set is generated only after training
controls use the exact same held-out episodes as the integrated arm within each seed
environment outcome enters only after the action
verified feedback writes are entity-addressed and only successful outcomes can modify authoritative state
CASM uses exact differentiable Boolean primitives in this phase
no auxiliary loss is available at inference
finite-grid result is descriptive and not an asymptotic law
